insight.title: You Think of Your Future Self as a Stranger
insight.subtitle: Why it is so easy to ignore your own long-term interests.

sections.text: You treat your future self like a stranger you don’t particularly like. When you think about who you will be in ten years, your brain shuts down the regions it uses to identify "you."
Mental activity shifts to the areas used to process people you’ve never met. To your brain, the person who has to deal with your choices next month is someone else entirely.
This is why it is easy to commit to a diet next Monday. You aren’t promising to do the work; you are volunteering a stranger to suffer while you enjoy the cake today.
You are leaving the bill for a person you’ve never met.
